question: Which pair of deities is assigned to the left thigh in this arrangement?
premises: Vivasvān and Dakṣa are named together.
Both are described as going to the left thigh.
inference: Vivasvān and Dakṣa together occupy the left thigh.
uncertainties: The placement of Mitra in relation to this pair is not explicitly stated in this verse.
plain_english: Then Vivasvān and Dakṣa, both, are located on the left thigh, and Mitra is also named.
